tara_sales: Quick sync for NovaBank POC next Tue. Requirements: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC group mapping, and domain lock. Can we scope a 10-day POC?
omar_se: SAML + SCIM 2.0 delta are supported. RBAC via SCIM group->role mapping or SAML group claims. Manual CSV import for initial users works too.
tara_sales: They insist on encrypted SAML assertions + signed assertions. Is that possible on Hosted?
sylvie_infosec: Hosted supports signed assertions (RSA-SHA256). Encrypted assertions are NOT enabled on Hosted by default. We can enable in Private or a short-lived dedicated test env (adds ~2-3 business days).
omar_se: For domain proofing we accept TXT or CNAME; CNAME preferred for automation. No CAA support in our verification flow.
tara_sales: SCIM throughput: will heavy provisioning count toward usage and blow up costs?
omar_se: SCIM calls fall under management API billing (not per-token). We have tiers (e.g., up to 25k ops/month included) then overage. We'll size based on user counts.
sylvie_infosec: I'll draft the security answers (supported algos, TLS versions, audit log retention 90d, SOC2 link) and call out Hosted limitation on encrypted assertions.
devops_bot: deploy note: no auth-related deploys in last 24h.
tara_sales: Please produce an IdOps checklist (SAML metadata fields, DNS steps, SCIM token creation, mapping options) + short security Q&A by EOD Friday. Thanks!
